meta.name: spring-data-jpa
meta.description: Designs and implements Spring Data JPA repositories, projections, query patterns, custom repositories, CQRS read models, entity relationships, and persistence performance fixes for Java 25 and Spring Boot 4 projects. Use when the task needs repository-boundary decisions or concrete JPA implementation patterns from this skill. Do not use for generic SQL help or project-wide migration work that belongs in another skill.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会帮你设计 Spring Data JPA 的持久层代码，包括仓库、查询、投影、自定义实现、CQRS 读模型、实体关系以及性能优化。
howto.when: 当任务涉及 Spring Boot 项目中的持久化设计或实现，例如决定仓库边界、选择查询模式或修复性能问题时触发。

say.text: 帮我为订单聚合根创建一个 JPA 仓库。
say.note: Claude 会按规则只给聚合根建仓库。

say.text: 这个查询需要多表连接和排序，用 @Query 实现。
say.note: Claude 会加载查询模式参考并生成 JPQL。

say.text: 这个读接口性能要求高，用 DTO 投影。
say.note: Claude 会使用投影模板来优化。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps design Spring Data JPA persistence code, including repositories, queries, projections, custom implementations, CQRS read models, entity relationships, and performance fixes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the task involves persistence design or implementation in a Spring Boot project, such as repository boundary decisions, query pattern selection, or performance fixes.

say_en.text: Create a JPA repository for the Order aggregate root.
say_en.note: Claude will only create repositories for aggregate roots.
